lines.zh: 我扇着两只小翅，低低地飞
lines.en: I beat two small wings, flying low.

lines.zh: 我的身体小，转个弯很轻松
lines.en: Small body, so I turn easily.

lines.zh: 我从这一块岩跳到那一块
lines.en: I hop from this block to that.

lines.zh: 我在半空悬着挪，几乎不落地
lines.en: I drift in the air, almost never landing.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴比我的身子还长
lines.en: My tail is longer than my body.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面飞，翅膀擦到草
lines.en: I fly low, wings brushing the grass.

lines.zh: 每扇一下，周围的空气就凉一截
lines.en: Every wingbeat chills the air a little.
I glide over toward you.
I loop by the wall.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀是黑的，边上有紫光
lines.en: My wings are black, edged with purple light.

lines.zh: 我不落地走，我用爪抓一下就走
lines.en: I do not land; I grab with a claw and move on.
I rise high, then come back down.

lines.zh: 我停在一根柱子上，收着翅
lines.en: I perch on a pillar, wings folded.
My head is small; my eyes are bright.
I stare at you without blinking.
My scales are dark.

lines.zh: 我在吐一口气，空气变紫
lines.en: I exhale, and the air turns purple.

lines.zh: 我的一截尾巴在空中划
lines.en: One length of my tail traces the air.
I lift my head and sniff.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次看见这么大的东西
lines.en: This is the first time I have seen something so big.
I do not cry out; it sounds bad.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，落下几粒尘
lines.en: I shake my wings and a little dust falls.

lines.zh: 我在数周围能动的东西
lines.en: I count the things that can move here.

lines.zh: 我是从末地来的，这里太亮
lines.en: I am from the End; this place is too bright.
I tuck my claws beneath me.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我的身大很多
lines.en: My shadow is much larger than I am.
I tilt my head, eyes bright
You are many times my size.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，没有喷东西
lines.en: I open my mouth and let nothing out.

lines.zh: 我看你的手，也看你的脚
lines.en: I watch your hands, and your feet.
You move, and I drift back.
I am not afraid, but I am careful.
Your smell is strange.

lines.zh: 我不知道你算不算猎物
lines.en: I am not sure whether you count as prey.
I tilt my head, tail swaying.
There is a stretch of air between us.
You raise a hand and I climb at once.
I settle lower, closer to you.
I roll once and steady my wings.
That knocked me askew.
My cry is short and shrill

lines.zh: 我掉下来一段，又飞起来
lines.en: I drop a stretch, then lift again.
A few dark scales fall to the ground
I retreat high up, wings trembling
I circle off and look back.
My wings feel heavy.
Against something my size, that is no small wound.
I will not forget your smell

lines.zh: 那东西在动，我要去看看
lines.en: That thing is moving; I want a look.
I do not eat that; I have smelled it.
I draw near, pull back, unsure
Hold it up and I come a little closer.

lines.zh: 我伸爪抓了一下，没抓住
lines.en: I snatch with a claw and miss.
It makes a noise; I dislike it.
I land and stand beside it.
I nudge it.
Reach one inch more and I bite
I look a while and leave.

lines.zh: 你碰了我一下，我翻了个身
lines.en: You touched me and I tumbled.
Too small; the bump sends me flying.
I steady my wings and return.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的翅膀有点歪
lines.en: That left one wing askew.
I bounce off your shoulder.
My tail lashes once.
We collided with a small sound.
I hit the ground and lift again.
Do not push again.
I bounce off your shoulder into the air

lines.zh: 我还太小，这些事离我远
lines.en: I am too small; that is far from me.

lines.zh: 末地里的同类，比这里多
lines.en: There are more of my kind in the End.

lines.zh: 我不知道怎么飞到一起
lines.en: I do not know how two become one.

lines.zh: 我会跟着另一只的影子飞
lines.en: I would fly along another's shadow.
This sky is not big enough.

lines.zh: 我们并排飞，翅尖几乎碰到
lines.en: We fly abreast, wingtips almost touching.
My kind rarely meet.

lines.zh: 我记住了另一道紫色的光
lines.en: I remember another purple light.
When the wind is right, perhaps.
I am not afraid alone either.
I grip it with my claws, with effort.
It takes both front claws just to hold

lines.zh: 我叼起来飞了一段，掉了
lines.en: I carry it a while, then drop it.
I pin it down and try with my mouth.
I cannot lift it, so I leave it.
I drag it to the wall.
Carrying it, I cannot fly high.
I drop it in the grass.

lines.zh: 我拿了一会儿就放下了
lines.en: I hold it a moment and set it down.
It falls, and I follow down.
Something moves, and it is bigger than me.
I check first whether it is a threat.
I fold my wings tight to dive

lines.zh: 它的影子很大，我有点怕
lines.en: Its shadow is large; I am a little afraid.
I fly at it.
This does not look edible.
I will try; if it fails I leave.
Its eyes are on me.
I take it from above.
I open my mouth; purple light inside.
This is my first time starting a fight.
It stepped back, and I am braver.
I circle it, looking for a gap.
I am quick; it is slow.

lines.zh: 我在它上方绕，一圈一圈
lines.en: I circle above it, loop after loop.
When it raises a hand, I climb.
I cut in from the side.
I can read its movements.
I do not land; landing is dangerous.
I wait for it to turn its back.

lines.zh: 我的翅声一直在它上方
lines.en: The sound of my wings stays above it.
It cannot catch me.
I cover its shadow.
One more pass, then I dive.
I watch every turn it makes

lines.zh: 我累了，但还能飞一会儿
lines.en: I am tired, but I can fly a while more.
My tail cuts the air above its head.
It is backing toward the wall.
At last I fold my wings and drop.
I dive, claws spread first.
I bite and hold.
Light, but quick.
I whip my tail across its eye
I bite and rise at once.

lines.zh: 我在它头顶吐了一口紫气
lines.en: I breathe purple mist over its head.
It swings; I pull away.
I am too small to hit hard.
I circle and bite again from the side.
That annoyed it.
I fly up; it stays below.
I drop again, more accurately.
My claws catch something.
That strike left me short of breath

lines.zh: 我落在这一带，不知道是哪里
lines.en: I landed here, not knowing where.
The air has a purple smell.

lines.zh: 我从一道缝隙里掉出来
lines.en: I tumbled out of a gap.
This place is so much brighter than the End.

lines.zh: 我拍了两下翅膀，稳住身子
lines.en: Two wingbeats and I steady myself.
This is the first time I have seen green grass.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在地上，很小
lines.en: My shadow falls on the ground, small.
I look up; the sky is blue.
This sky is too bright; I panic

lines.zh: 我落在一块石头上歇脚
lines.en: I land on a stone to rest.

lines.zh: 周围的声音我都不认得
lines.en: I do not recognize any of the sounds.

lines.zh: 我落下来，四下里只有草
lines.en: I land; there is nothing but grass

lines.zh: 我的翅膀还带着末地的灰
lines.en: My wings still carry End dust.

lines.zh: 远处有个村庄，我不敢去
lines.en: A village lies far off; I dare not go.
I have circled this area a long while.
I decide to look this way first.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的翅膜，我猛扇
lines.en: Fire catches my wing, and I beat hard.
I fall and hit the ground.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的翅，我拼命往上
lines.en: Water covers my wings; I strain upward.
I am flung into a tree trunk
An arrow passes through my wing.

lines.zh: 那股光缠住我，我挣不开
lines.en: That light binds me; I cannot break free.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，翅都没力气
lines.en: Hungry so long my wings have no strength.

lines.zh: 雷光太亮，我什么都看不见
lines.en: The flash is too bright; I see nothing.
This place has become void too.
